review.assessment: The change directly targets the documented root cause in `pipeline/ingest.py`. By routing flag values through `normalize.canonical_flag()` before checking against `constants.VALID_FLAGS`, it stops the silent discard of rev B firmware records that used upper-case flags. This restores expected sample volumes and populates downstream aggregation windows, which resolves the empty-list condition that caused the ZeroDivisionError in `pipeline/stats.py`.

findings.actual: AttributeError or TypeError inside normalize.canonical_flag() when passed None
findings.call: python3 run.py data/samples.jsonl (with a valid record missing the flag key)
findings.expected: Records without the flag key should be explicitly dropped or handled gracefully before canonicalization

findings.at: pipeline/ingest.py header (imports not shown in diff)
findings.expected: The normalize module must be imported at the top of ingest.py to resolve the canonical_flag call
